title: Review a consolidation worksheet — Pardo and Sorell
instructions: Pardo Corp. acquired 80% of Sorell Inc. on January 1 of the prior year. A staff accountant prepared this year's consolidated amounts. Review them against the separate-company data and the intercompany information. Tick every amount that is wrong and enter the correct amount.

exhibits.title: Separate-company amounts for the year
exhibits.content:
| | Pardo (parent) | Sorell (80%) |
|---|---:|---:|
| Sales | 1,500,000 | 800,000 |
| Cost of goods sold | (900,000) | (520,000) |
| Operating expenses | (270,000) | (160,000) |
| Dividend income from Sorell | 24,000 | — |
| **Net income** | **354,000** | **120,000** |
| Accounts receivable, December 31 | 180,000 | 95,000 |
| Inventory, December 31 | 260,000 | 140,000 |
| Accounts payable, December 31 | 150,000 | 90,000 |

exhibits.title: Intercompany and acquisition information
exhibits.content:
- During the year Sorell sold goods to Pardo for **$200,000**. Sorell's gross margin on these sales is **25%** of the selling price. At December 31, Pardo still held **$40,000** (at Pardo's cost) of these goods.
- At December 31, Pardo owed Sorell **$35,000** for these purchases.
- Sorell paid dividends of **$30,000** during the year; Pardo recorded its share as dividend income.
- Acquisition-date fair value adjustments to Sorell's buildings are amortized at **$8,000** a year. They are not recorded on Sorell's books.
- The noncontrolling interest is allocated its share of Sorell's income after the amortization and the upstream profit deferral.

parts.prompt: Review the consolidated income statement amounts.

rows.label: Cost of goods sold
rows.explanation: 1,420,000 − 200,000 intercompany + 10,000 unrealized profit in Pardo's ending inventory (40,000 × 25%) = **1,230,000**. The draft eliminated the sale but did not defer the profit.

rows.label: Operating expenses (including amortization of acquisition-date fair value adjustments)
Dividend income
rows.explanation: Dividends from a consolidated subsidiary are intercompany and are eliminated: **0**.

rows.label: Net income attributable to the noncontrolling interest
rows.explanation: Sale is **upstream** (Sorell to Pardo), so the deferred profit is shared: 20% × (120,000 − 8,000 − 10,000) = **20,400**.

parts.prompt: Review the consolidated balance sheet amounts.

rows.label: Accounts payable
rows.explanation: 150,000 + 90,000 − 35,000 intercompany payable = **205,000**. **No error** — but the draft eliminated the payable without the matching receivable, so it could not have balanced.
